slides.s: PMP-Certified Engineering Leader | 21 Years in Software, DevOps & AI-Driven Engineering Transformation
slides.n: Please welcome {name}, a PMP-certified engineering leader with 21 years of experience spanning software development, QA, DevOps, and technology leadership. Over the last 8 years, {he} has built and led high-performing engineering teams, driving platform modernization, security, and agentic AI adoption across enterprise-scale products.

items: F5 Innovation India · Jul 2025-Sep 2026 — Led a 10-member team on BIG-IP control plane services, reduced upgrade time by ~90%, drove security hardening (DAC/MAC, SELinux), and built 7-8 agentic AI agents for CVE remediation and bug resolution.

Cisco Systems India · Mar 2020-Jul 2025 — Led Webex developer experience team; architected distributed Webex-Microsoft Teams presence/calling integration using Kafka, Redis, and Java; drove AI-based automated code generation for Webex SDKs.

Cisco Systems India · Apr 2018-Feb 2020 — Led developers, testers, and release engineers on Cisco Expressway; drove Python/C++ platform features, Erlang-based DB upgrades, and DevOps release infrastructure improvements.

Cisco Systems India · Apr 2008-Feb 2018 — Owned functional, regression, and automation testing for Cisco Call Manager and Expressway; handled customer escalations and drove automation coverage toward 100% using SIP, H.323, RTP protocols.
slides.n: {Name}'s recent career reflects a steady rise into engineering leadership. At F5, {he} led control-plane security and AI transformation initiatives, cutting upgrade times dramatically. At Cisco, {he} architected complex distributed systems connecting Webex and Microsoft Teams, and earlier led development and QA automation teams delivering Cisco's VoIP and gateway products.

items: Verizon India · May 2007-Mar 2008 — Performed end-to-end call-flow, regression testing, and bug verification for IP-converged contact center solutions covering IVR and prepaid dialing.
Alcatel India · Jan 2007-Apr 2008 — Conducted functional and regression testing and developed test cases for Alcatel OmniPCX Enterprise PBX solutions across multiple releases.
slides.n: {Name}'s career began in quality assurance, where {he} built a strong foundation in telecom and VoIP testing. At Verizon and Alcatel, {he} validated complex call-flow systems and PBX solutions, setting the stage for {his} later growth into engineering leadership.

{Name} brings a rare blend of deep technical expertise and leadership skill. {He} is highly experienced in engineering management and VoIP protocols from years of hands-on work, while more recently building strong capabilities in agentic AI, distributed systems, and cloud-native DevOps practices.

The numbers highlight {name}'s impact: 21 years in the industry, including 8 in engineering management, {he} led initiatives that cut upgrade time by roughly 90%, resolved over 100 long-lived defects and CVEs, and built 7 to 8 AI agents to automate issue resolution and remediation.

{Name}'s foundation combines a Bachelor's in Electronic and Communication Engineering with a PMP certification and a more recent Postgraduate Program in Artificial Intelligence from the University of Texas at Austin, reflecting {his} ongoing commitment to staying at the forefront of technology.

Thank you for learning about {name}'s journey — from hands-on QA engineering to leading AI-driven engineering transformation. With deep technical grounding and proven leadership, {he} continues to drive innovation, security, and efficiency across enterprise engineering teams.
